capabilities: Reload plugins automatically when main.js, manifest.json, styles.css, or data.json change
Serve plugin updates from a desktop server to mobile clients
Connect as a client to download and apply plugin updates
Auto-detect plugins to watch via .git folders or .hotreload files
Optionally synchronize data.json plugin settings across devices
extras: The manifest notes: 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.'
intentEvidence: This plugin incorporates logic and ideas from obsidian-hot-reload by PJ Eby
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to apply plugin code changes instantly during development, especially on mobile devices.

relations.evidence: This plugin incorporates logic and ideas from obsidian-hot-reload by PJ Eby

summary: Developer tool that hot-reloads Obsidian plugins on desktop and mobile by watching plugin files, with a built-in server-client bridge.
